acrewcapital-vanta-com:ashbyhq:0d8925dc-.description: At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. As a Solutions Engineer for New Markets, you’ll be leading the technical discussion with our key prospects & customers in Japan, guiding customers toward clarity, feasibility, and alignment on the end-to-end solution. You’ll be an integral part of the Sales team, working both pre and post-sales to ensure technical fit and create innovative solutions for our customers. You will also serve as a bridge between our product development team and our customers, utilizing your strong communication skills to deliver pointed and actionable feedback that our product teams might use to ensure Vanta gets 1% better every day. This role will be based in our Tokyo, Japan office with a hybrid working model. What you’ll do as a Solutions Engineer at Vanta: - Partner with pre and post sales to identify, qualify and drive net new, expansion and renewal opportunities - Develop a deep understanding of our product capabilities, integrations, configurations messaging, partner ecosystem, and competitive landscape. - Build and maintain strong technical partnerships with our customers via engaging product demonstrations, trials, and other communications - Develop a trusted advisor relationship with key accounts, customer stakeholders, and executive sponsors that may lead to renewals, expansion, and advocacy - Influence Vanta’s strategy and product priorities to drive adoption and retention by being the voice of the customer - Cultivate an environment of teamwork, openness, creativity, and continuous improvement - Work cross-functionally to resolve customer business issues and work toward mutual goals - Develop processes and workflows that allow us to build and scale a best-in-class Solutions Engineering organization How to be successful in this role: - 4+ years of customer-facing, technical experience as a Solutions Engineer, Sales Engineer or equivalent title - You exhibit outstanding communication abilities and feel equally at ease when presenting to both individual contributors and decision-makers - You have a track record of working on multiple projects simultaneously, while operating independently to drive projects to completion - Hands-on experience with cloud platforms: AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure & Operating Systems (Windows, MacOS, Linux) and cloud application architecture - Strong project management skills with a proven ability to operate in a startup environment that lacks structure of a larger organization - You are creative, curious, technical, and naturally persuasive - You are detail-oriented and organized - You love listening to customers, discussing strategy with colleagues, but also diving into the weeds - You can interact with various titles and roles within an organization including the technical and security-minded, plus executives within large companies - Familiarity with REST API development and service integrations is a plus - Ideally has prior B2B SaaS experience - Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact. aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:814.description: Company Information For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer. Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations. If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer! What We Are Looking For The Digital Media Buyer will be responsible for planning, executing, and monitoring media strategies to drive successful outreach through established partnerships and business agreements. The primary objectives of this role are to increase tour awareness, strengthen advertising campaigns, enhance marketing strategies, and boost event sales. This position reports to the Director of Media and will work closely with the media team, community manager, design manager, and project manager to oversee campaigns from start to finish. The role requires strong analytical skills, the ability to prioritize tasks, identify trends and insights, and optimize spending. The Digital Media Buyer will manage all digital marketing campaigns, monitor performance in real time, and provide detailed reporting to the touring team. assistworld-assist-world:lever:dfff7e48-.title: Bilingual Virtual Assistant – Medical Practice
assistworld-assist-world:lever:dfff7e48-.description: The client is a primary care physician running a solo private practice that she opened about a year ago. The practice is currently part-time with a patient load of under 300, operates on an insurance-based model, and is located near the Texas-Mexico border, serving a patient base that is mostly English-speaking with a meaningful number of Spanish speakers. Dr. Garcia-Davalos currently works with one in-person medical assistant who checks in patients, takes vitals, and verifies insurance, alongside a third-party billing company that handles claims. Role Overview The client is going on maternity leave starting in September and will not be in the office at all for at least that month. Since no patients will be coming in during that time, she does not need in-person support — but she still expects calls and messages from existing patients about medication refills, appointment questions, and upcoming visits scheduled later in the year. She is also using this period to begin transitioning the practice from an insurance-based to a cash-based model, so this role is about holding things down reliably while she is out and helping keep patient communication organized as the practice evolves. Key Responsibilities • Answer incoming patient phone calls via the practice's VoIP line (QUO/OpenPhone), including medication refill requests, scheduling questions, and general patient inquiries • Relay medication refill requests to the client for her personal review and sign-off — the VA does not send refills directly • Monitor and manage the practice email inbox, including incoming faxes (medical records) and new patient inquiries submitted through the website • Let prospective new patients know the practice has a temporary waitlist and is not currently scheduling new patient appointments • Assist existing patients with questions about upcoming scheduled visits (the practice sees patients approximately one week per month from October through December) • Communicate directly with the client as needed via WhatsApp, iMessage, or Zoom • Help document and maintain SOPs during the practice's transition to a cash-based model, laying the groundwork for a smoother handoff when an in-person MA is hired again Skills & Tools • Bilingual: fluent in English and Spanish strongly preferred • HIPAA certified • Comfortable with VoIP/phone systems (e.g., QUO/OpenPhone) and standard email platforms • Minimum 3–4 years of relevant experience (medical office, patient-facing, or virtual assistant experience) • Strong attention to detail and discretion handling sensitive medical information • Reliable and self-directed, comfortable working independently with light day-to-day oversight

axiomtalentplatform-axiomtalentplatform:.description: Axiom is supporting a high‑growth technology business seeking an immediately available legal contractor to provide interim support to its payments and regulatory function for a 3–4‑month engagement. This role sits within a fast‑paced, product‑driven environment and will work closely with senior leaders across payments, risk, and compliance to maintain momentum while permanent hiring is underway. The engagement offers full flexibility on location, weekly hours, and seniority level, provided the contractor can operate autonomously and deliver pragmatic, commercially grounded regulatory advice. This opportunity would suit a payments‑focused legal professional who thrives in agile, tech‑enabled settings and is comfortable managing varied workstreams across product development, regulatory interpretation, and cross‑functional stakeholder engagement. Responsibilities: Assists in the development and expansion of payments products across the Australian, US, and UK markets. Provides guidance to Product and Engineering teams on AFSL, AML, and broader risk‑management obligations. Delivers legal insight and risk‑mitigation support for high‑priority strategic initiatives and incident response matters. Builds and maintains strong working relationships with regulators and technical subject‑matter experts. Works closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Privacy teams to embed financial‑crime considerations into product design. Supports day‑to‑day legal operations to ensure continuity and momentum across the payments legal workstream. Requirements: Brings practical experience in payments and financial services, ideally gained in tech‑enabled or product‑driven environments rather than large traditional financial institutions. Demonstrates strong working knowledge of licensing, anti‑money‑laundering requirements, and broader regulatory risk frameworks relevant to payments operations. Communicates complex regulatory concepts clearly and works effectively in fast‑moving, cross‑functional settings with minimal oversight. Manages multiple priorities confidently and fits within a flexible engagement model, whether full‑time for a shorter period or part‑time across the full 3–4‑month term. Why Rejoin Axiom? Flexibility: Choose assignments that fit your lifestyle and career goals. Professional Growth: Continue to develop your expertise through diverse projects. Community: Reconnect with a network of forward-thinking legal professionals. Impact: Contribute to impactful work with leading global organizations. Compensation, Benefits & Location: This role offers a highly competitive compensation and benefits package in the alternative legal services marketplace, that includes health benefits, pension and more. Axiomites also get access to professional development resources and learning and development programs. Axiomites predominately work remotely, with the exception that some clients require on-site presence. Axiom is the global leader in high-calibre, on-demand legal talent. Covering North America, the UK, Europe, and APAC, we enable legal departments to drive efficiency and growth and meet the demands of today’s business landscape with best in breed alterative legal services. Axiom is a leader in diversity, inclusion, and social engagement. Diversity is core to our values and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are proud to be named a best place to work for LGBTQ+ Equality, earning top marks in the 2021 Corporate Equality Index for the second consecutive year. blackboxstrategies-blackbox-strategies:a.title: Email & CRM Marketing Specialist
blackboxstrategies-blackbox-strategies:a.description: EMAIL & CRM MARKETING SPECIALIST ROLE OVERVIEW BlackBox Strategies is seeking a senior, execution-first operator to own outbound and lifecycle messaging across both B2B and B2C audiences. This role is ideal for someone who: - Is an expert at hands-on execution - Can collaborate on strategy, then independently ship - Understands how B2B and B2C motions differ across email, CRM, and SMS - Works closely with a Social Media Manager to align messaging and timing You will partner with leadership on direction and priorities, then own execution end-to-end. ABOUT BLACKBOX STRATEGIES BlackBox Strategies is a revenue execution agency that helps businesses grow through disciplined GTM strategy, outbound execution, and lifecycle optimization. We design and operate revenue systems across email, CRM, and digital channels—bridging strategy and hands-on execution to drive measurable results for both B2B and B2C clients. LOCATION Remote | Open to global candidates (U.S. business hours required) KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Cold Email & Outbound Execution - Build and maintain outbound lists and enrichment workflows using Clay - Launch, manage, and optimize cold email campaigns in Instantly - Own inbox health, deliverability, warm-up, and reply categorization - Sync replies, outcomes, and lifecycle stages into HubSpot - Continuously test messaging by segment, persona, and intent Lifecycle & Marketing Email (B2B + B2C) - Build segmented audiences across lead, prospect, and customer stages - Execute nurture, re-engagement, abandoned inquiry, and expansion campaigns - Manage compliance, suppression logic, and list hygiene - Use HubSpot Marketing Hub and/or Mailchimp SMS Marketing (Nice to Have) - Support compliant, high-intent SMS use cases (follow-ups, reminders, re-engagement) - Experience with platforms such as Twilio or similar is a strong plus - Coordinate SMS timing with email and social campaigns Cross-Functional Collaboration - Collaborate closely with the Social Media Manager to align themes, CTAs, and timing - Share outbound insights to inform social and content strategy - Partner with leadership on ICPs, testing priorities, and iteration REQUIREMENTS - Minimum of 4 years of hands-on experience in outbound, lifecycle marketing, or RevOps-adjacent roles - Direct experience executing (not just overseeing) email and CRM campaigns - Experience supporting both B2B and B2C audiences - Strong understanding of deliverability, segmentation, and channel tradeoffs - Clear written communicator with a bias toward execution - Comfortable operating with high-level direction in a fast-moving environment BENEFITS - Competitive compensation - Flexible, fully remote work environment - Opportunity to directly influence pipeline and revenue - Close collaboration with strategy, social, and GTM leadership - Exposure to modern outbound, CRM, and AI-enabled workflows

bumbleinc-bumbleinc:lever:460c4b8e-fbe7-.description: Bumble's Creative Studio is an exciting inflection point, supporting Bumble Inc.'s portfolio of apps globally. We're looking to hire a Graphic Designer to be a part of our small but mighty team, working on global projects and across time zones. In this role within the Creative Studio, you'll help develop effective, exciting, and culturally relevant work for our portfolio of brands. You'll be part of a full-service, in-house, geographically diverse creative team of designers, art directors, copywriters, video editors, and producers who work hand-in-hand with external production and agency partners. The person we are looking for is a vibrant Graphic Designer who brings both craft and fresh thinking to every project. With a growing command of design across print, digital, social and campaign work, they're detail-oriented and bring innovative ideas to the team. Your work will span a wide variety of communications, from social and growth content to marketing and partnership campaigns, in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where your creativity and technical skills will play a crucial role in producing compelling designs. This role is based in the US, reporting to the Design Lead in the UK. Designing across a broad range of communications for Bumble Inc.'s diverse brands, spanning social, growth, CRM, ASO, marketing, and partnership campaigns globally. Developing creative concepts and translating them into visually compelling designs across print and digital media. Collaborating closely with copywriters, motion designers and art directors to produce cohesive, engaging work across all brands. Contributing creative ideas actively in brainstorming and concepting sessions to enhance overall design quality. Presenting work to key stakeholders, clearly explaining the assignment and the rationale behind your design decisions. Upholding and championing Bumble Inc.'s brand standards across all markets and touchpoints, ensuring consistency at every level. Managing your own workload effectively, and flagging any resource or timeline considerations proactively. The ideal candidate will have a strong portfolio that demonstrates a keen eye for detail and versatile design thinking. They're comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, with the energy and curiosity to bring innovative ideas to every brief. They're a self-starter who works comfortably both autonomously and as part of a collaborative, geographically diverse creative team. They'll set a high bar through the quality of their craft and the thoughtfulness of their creative contributions, while remaining open to direction and eager to grow. gendigital-gen-digital:ashbyhq:54cc4aba-.title: Lead Software Engineer - Financial Wellness
gendigital-gen-digital:ashbyhq:54cc4aba-.description: ABOUT US: Gen is a global company dedicated to powering Digital Freedom through its trusted consumer brands including Norton, Avast, LifeLock, MoneyLion and more. Our combined heritage is rooted in financial empowerment and cyber safety for the first digital generations, and today we deliver award-winning cybersecurity, online privacy, identity protection and financial wellness solutions to nearly 500 million users in more than 150 countries. Together, we share a collective passion and vision to protect consumers and help them grow, manage and secure their digital and financial lives. We’re always looking for smart, fearless and high-impact talent who see AI as a teammate – leveraging it to move faster and deliver meaningful results. When you’re part of Gen, you’ll have the flexibility, tools and support to do your best work and grow your career – from flexible working options and time off to competitive pay, benefits and well-being programs. At Gen, we are scrappy and relentlessly customer driven. We create room for healthy debate, experimentation and continuous learning, and we seek out people with different experiences, identities and ideas to join our team. You’ll work with people who back each other, respect each other and understand that our differences are a competitive advantage. If this sounds like you, we’d love you to be part of Gen. ABOUT THE ROLE: Gen Digital is building a Financial Wellness platform that powers Norton Money, Norton 360 and LifeLock, spanning bank-linking, transactions and insights, credit, identity protection and a digital marketplace for financial products. We’re looking for a Lead Backend Software Engineer to lead the backend architecture for the Gen Financial Wellness platform. You’ll own critical services end-to-end, set technical direction, and work across teams to deliver secure, reliable and compliant financial experiences at scale. In this role, you will: - Own and evolve backend services for Financial Wellness (Norton Money, Norton 360, Norton Genie and LifeLock) from design and implementation to operations and observability (Java/Spring Boot on AWS, Postgres, Kafka). - Design and review REST APIs and data contracts between internal and external services, providers, keeping them secure, versioned and easy to integrate. - Champion event-driven architectures and telemetry pipelines for offers, leads, financial events and alerts, using Kafka and well-governed schemas. - Drive reliability and performance: SLOs, capacity planning, multi-AZ resilience, performance and endurance testing, and incident response for your services. - Partner with Security, Privacy and Legal to ensure backend designs meet PII, credit-reporting and regulatory requirements across Gen product portfolio. - Mentor engineers, lead design reviews and help shape the long-term technical roadmap for Financial Wellness backends at Gen. About you: MUST-HAVES - Strong experience building backend services in Java (Spring Boot or similar) and operating them in production at scale. - Hands-on expertise with cloud-native architectures on AWS (ECS/EKS or Fargate, RDS/Aurora, VPC, load balancers, WAF, S3, Secrets Manager). - Solid knowledge of relational databases (Postgres or equivalent) and at least one NoSQL store (e.g., DynamoDB, DocumentDB), including schema design and migrations. - Experience with event streaming/messaging (Kafka or similar) and event-driven system design. - A track record of owning architecture for a product/domain, influencing cross-team decisions and working directly with senior stakeholders. - Strong understanding of secure software design (authN/authZ, least privilege, PII handling, auditing) and comfort working with security/compliance reviews. NICE-TO-HAVES - Background in financial services, financial wellness, embedded finance, banking or credit products, or identity-/privacy-focused platforms. - Experience with serverless (API Gateway, Lambda, Step Functions, DynamoDB, Redis) and/or integrating with AI

jobgether-jobgether:lever:30f02a23-5af3-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a User Acquisition Manager (Meta, New Project) based in India. This is a hands-on growth role with full ownership of Meta as a core acquisition channel for a new AI-powered EdTech product. You’ll manage significant paid media budgets while optimizing toward sustainable ROAS, LTV, and scalable growth. The role combines campaign execution, experimentation, funnel optimization, and performance analysis in an automation-first environment. You’ll work closely with product and creative teams to test new concepts, improve conversion, and identify high-potential growth levers. Beyond managing campaigns, you’ll help refine the systems and automation that enable user acquisition to operate efficiently at scale. The environment is global, remote, fast-moving, and highly focused on measurable performance and continuous experimentation. This is an opportunity for an experienced UA professional to have direct impact on a new product’s growth trajectory. Own Meta Ads acquisition end-to-end, from campaign setup and structure through ongoing optimization and scaling. Manage significant monthly paid social budgets with a strong focus on ROAS, LTV, acquisition efficiency, and sustainable growth. Develop, launch, test, and scale campaign structures and acquisition strategies based on performance data. Work hands-on within advertising accounts to monitor performance, identify issues, and implement optimization opportunities.
